Important safety information

Meet Minoxidil + Supplement Blend Chew

  • Treat hair loss with this once-a-day chew

  • Custom-formulated with prescription-strength ingredients

  • 100% online, unlimited access to care

How it works

  • Minoxidil brings oxygen and nutrients to the scalp by increasing blood flow to hair follicles

  • Activates hair out of its resting phase and into growth

  • Extends hair’s growth phase for longer, for sustained growth activity

Ingredients

  • 3mg minoxidil

  • Proprietary blend of supplements (biotin, vitamin B5, vitamin B6, vitamin C) that supports healthy hair

Hair Hybrids are compounded products. FDA does not approve nor verify the safety, effectiveness, or quality of compounded drugs. Rx required.
